name: AquaPure Compact Under-Sink RO
blurb: An all-in-one reverse osmosis system with the storage tank built into the body, so it fits the cupboard under a normal apartment sink without a separate tank taking up the space beside it.
features: Storage tank built into the unit — no separate tank to find room for
Quick-connect cartridges we can swap in minutes on a service visit
Built-in leak detector cuts the supply before water reaches your floor
Pressure-reducing valve protects the membrane and your plumbing
Dedicated lead-free drinking faucet fitted at your sink
Booster pump option for buildings with weak mains pressure
metaDescription: All-in-one under-sink reverse osmosis with the tank built in — designed for UAE apartment cupboards. Supplied, installed and serviced with a free water test.
directAnswer: An all-in-one under-sink reverse osmosis system with the storage tank built into the body, so it occupies a single footprint inside a normal apartment sink cupboard instead of needing a separate tank beside it. It suits households that draw several litres at a time and have cupboard width but not room for two objects.
keyFacts: Tank integrated into the unit — one footprint, not two
Stored purified water, so a fast flow at the faucet from a modest pump
Quick-connect cartridges, changed in minutes on a service visit
Built-in leak detection and a pressure-reducing valve

whoItSuits.title: Apartment kitchens with cupboard width
whoItSuits.body: The common case. If the cupboard can take one unit but not a unit plus a tank, this is the system designed for that situation.

whoItSuits.title: Families drawing several litres at once
whoItSuits.body: Stored water is what gives a fast flow when filling a jug or a pot. A tankless unit purifies on demand and delivers more slowly.

whoItSuits.title: Buildings with adequate mains pressure
whoItSuits.body: Where pressure at your floor is weak, the booster pump option becomes part of the specification rather than an extra.

howItFits: Mounted inside the sink cupboard, plumbed from the cold feed with an isolation valve, and drained to the sink waste through a properly clamped saddle.
A dedicated lead-free drinking faucet is fitted at the sink — using an existing tap hole or sink knockout where one is available, which matters in rented apartments and on stone worktops.

maintenance.title: Pre-filters about every 6 months
maintenance.body: Quick-connect formats make this a short visit rather than a plumbing job.

maintenance.title: Membrane every 2 to 3 years
maintenance.body: Judged on the treated TDS reading rather than the date.

maintenance.title: Tank air charge
maintenance.body: Checked at service. A tank that has lost its charge presents as low pressure at the faucet.

considerations.title: Measure the cupboard, including depth
considerations.body: Behind the waste trap is where the space runs out. This is what decides between this unit and the tankless one more often than any specification.

considerations.title: Confirm pressure before buying
considerations.body: A membrane starved of feed pressure produces slowly, drains more and fails early — and the symptom looks like a faulty system.

specNote: Exact capacities, dimensions, stage counts and pump specifications are confirmed per model on the written quotation, after the water test and the site survey. We do not publish specification tables, because the configuration is chosen for your property rather than picked from a catalogue.

operatingLimits.label: Feed pressure
operatingLimits.note: Below the minimum, a booster pump is part of the system rather than an accessory. On a high floor or in an older building this is the single most common reason a system 'does not work'.

operatingLimits.label: Feed temperature
operatingLimits.note: Worth checking in a UAE summer. Water that has stood in a roof tank through the afternoon can arrive well above 38 °C, which is outside the rated range for the membrane — a local constraint that generic specifications do not mention.

operatingLimits.label: Maximum feed TDS
operatingLimits.note: Desalinated mains supply is normally far below this. Tanker-filled and well-fed properties are where it needs checking.

operatingLimits.label: Maximum hardness
operatingLimits.note: Above this, hardness is reduced before the RO or the membrane scales. This is what decides whether a softener has to precede the drinking-water system.

operatingLimits.label: Maximum free chlorine
operatingLimits.note: Chlorine oxidises a thin-film membrane. This limit is precisely why carbon pre-treatment is not an optional upgrade — it protects the most expensive part of the system.

operatingLimits.label: Maximum iron / manganese
operatingLimits.note: Both stain fittings and foul membranes well before they are visible in a glass.

operatingLimits.label: Maximum turbidity
operatingLimits.note: Sediment pre-filtration exists to keep the feed inside this figure.

limitsNote: These are the feed-water limits published for representative residential RO equipment, taken from manufacturer documentation held on file. They are not a quotation and not your unit's data sheet — they are the envelope the technology needs, and the reason we measure your water before recommending anything. Your configured system's figures are confirmed in writing after the site survey.

name: AquaPure Slim Tankless RO
blurb: Purifies on demand instead of storing water in a tank, in a casing slim enough to stand where a conventional system will not fit. The one we recommend when cupboard space is genuinely tight.
features: Tankless — water is purified as you draw it, nothing sits in storage
Slim upright casing fits narrow under-sink cupboards
TDS readout on the unit so you can check your water any time
Filter-change reminder, plus low-pressure and leak warning lights
Neat enough to stand on a countertop where there is no cupboard
Cartridges designed for tool-free replacement
metaDescription: Tankless reverse osmosis that purifies on demand with a TDS readout and filter-change alerts. Slim enough for tight under-sink cupboards. Free water test.
directAnswer: A tankless reverse osmosis system that purifies water as you draw it rather than storing it, in a slim upright casing that fits cupboards a conventional system will not. It is what we recommend when cupboard depth is genuinely the constraint, and it needs a higher-output membrane and pump to deliver a usable flow.
keyFacts: Nothing is stored — water is purified on demand
Slim upright casing for narrow or shallow under-sink cupboards
TDS readout on the unit, so you can check the water yourself
Filter-change reminder plus low-pressure and leak warnings

whoItSuits.title: Tight apartment cupboards
whoItSuits.body: The reason this system exists. No storage vessel means far less depth and no second object to find room for.

whoItSuits.title: Households that dislike stored water
whoItSuits.body: On-demand purification means nothing sits between draws.

whoItSuits.title: Countertop installations
whoItSuits.body: Neat enough to stand on a worktop where there is no usable cupboard at all.

howItFits: Stands upright inside the cupboard or on the counter, plumbed from the cold feed with an isolation valve and drained to the sink waste.
Because production is on demand, the pump and membrane are doing more work per litre than in a tanked system — which is why feed pressure and a stable power supply both matter here.

maintenance.title: Tool-free cartridge changes
maintenance.body: Designed so a service visit does not mean dismantling the cupboard.

maintenance.title: Watch the on-unit TDS readout
maintenance.body: The most useful early warning of a membrane losing rejection that any home system offers.

maintenance.title: Membrane every 2 to 3 years
maintenance.body: Higher-output membranes are not longer-lived; the interval is the same.

considerations.title: Flow rate versus household size
considerations.body: A large family filling several containers at once will find on-demand production slower than a tank. This is the real trade, and it is worth being honest about before purchase.

considerations.title: Higher purchase price for the same treatment
considerations.body: You are paying for the space saving and the on-demand behaviour, not for better filtration.

specNote: Exact capacities, dimensions, stage counts and pump specifications are confirmed per model on the written quotation, after the water test and the site survey. We do not publish specification tables, because the configuration is chosen for your property rather than picked from a catalogue.

operatingLimits.label: Feed pressure
operatingLimits.note: A tankless unit needs MORE feed pressure than a tank system, not less: there is no stored buffer to draw from, so the membrane has to meet demand in real time. This is the specification that most often rules a tankless unit out.

operatingLimits.label: Feed temperature
operatingLimits.note: As with any RO membrane. Summer roof-tank temperatures are the thing to check.

operatingLimits.label: Maximum free chlorine
operatingLimits.note: Carbon pre-treatment protects the membrane from oxidation.

operatingLimits.label: Typical treated output
operatingLimits.note: Produced on demand rather than stored, which is the whole point of the format.

limitsNote: These are the feed-water limits published for representative residential RO equipment, taken from manufacturer documentation held on file. They are not a quotation and not your unit's data sheet — they are the envelope the technology needs, and the reason we measure your water before recommending anything. Your configured system's figures are confirmed in writing after the site survey.

name: AquaPure Modular RO with UV Option
blurb: A serviceable, modular under-sink system on a steel frame, with an optional UV stage. This is what we fit for villas on tanker or roof-tank supply, where drinking water needs sterilising as well as purifying.
features: Modular housings — each stage inspected and changed independently
Optional UV stage for tanker-fed and roof-tank properties
Optional booster pump where mains pressure is low
Antimicrobial cartridge option to resist biofilm inside the housings
Pressure gauge so our technician can read the membrane's condition
Floor-standing or wall-mounted frame to suit the cupboard
metaDescription: Serviceable modular RO with an optional UV sterilisation stage and booster pump, fitted for UAE villas on tanker or roof-tank supply.
h1: AquaPure Modular RO with UV Option
directAnswer: A serviceable modular under-sink RO on a steel frame with an optional UV stage. It is what we fit for villas on tanker or roof-tank supply, where drinking water needs disinfecting as well as purifying — because filtration and disinfection are different jobs and a cartridge does not do the second one.
keyFacts: Modular housings — each stage inspected and changed independently
Optional UV stage for tank-fed and tanker-fed properties
Pressure gauge, so a technician can read the membrane's condition
Optional booster pump where feed pressure is low

whoItSuits.title: Villas on tank or tanker supply
whoItSuits.body: The primary case. Stored water carries a risk that filtration does not address, and the UV stage is the part that does.

whoItSuits.title: Properties used seasonally
whoItSuits.body: Where a system may stand unused for months, serviceability and disinfection both matter more than compactness.

whoItSuits.title: Anyone who wants the system readable
whoItSuits.body: A gauge and independent housings mean the system's condition can be assessed rather than guessed at.

howItFits: Floor-standing or wall-mounted on a steel frame, sized to the cupboard or the utility space, with isolation valves and clearance to open each housing.
The UV stage sits after filtration, never before it: particles shield organisms from the light, so a UV chamber fed unfiltered water delivers much less protection than its rating suggests.

maintenance.title: Stages changed independently
maintenance.body: You replace what is exhausted rather than a sealed cartridge block.

maintenance.title: UV lamp annually, on running hours
maintenance.body: Output falls long before a lamp stops lighting. The quartz sleeve is cleaned or replaced at the same visit.

maintenance.title: Gauge readings recorded
maintenance.body: A growing pressure differential reports a developing blockage before flow noticeably drops.

considerations.title: Larger footprint than a sealed unit
considerations.body: Modularity costs space. In an apartment cupboard that is usually the wrong trade; in a villa utility space it is the right one.

considerations.title: UV needs power that stays on
considerations.body: A UV chamber with no power is a plain pipe. Worth siting on a circuit nobody switches off.

name: AquaPure Self-Cleaning Villa Pre-Filter
blurb: The first line of defence for a villa on tanker or roof-tank water. Instead of a cartridge you throw away, it has a reusable mesh that you rinse clean by opening a valve — sand and rust go straight down the drain.
features: Self-cleaning: open the drain valve and the mesh flushes itself
Reusable mesh element — no cartridge to keep buying
Clear bowl, so you can actually see the sand and rust it is catching
Protects every filter, softener, geyser and appliance downstream
Versions for cold lines and for hot water lines
Pressure-gauge version so blockage is visible before flow drops
Fitted at the point of entry, before anything else in the property
metaDescription: Point-of-entry self-cleaning filter with a reusable mesh you rinse by opening a valve. Protects villa plumbing and appliances from tanker-water sand and rust.
directAnswer: A point-of-entry sediment filter with a reusable mesh element that you rinse by opening a drain valve, instead of a cartridge you replace. It is the first fitting we recommend on a villa fed by tanker or a storage tank, because sand and rust in that duty block a disposable cartridge faster than anyone wants to keep replacing it.
keyFacts: Reusable mesh — rinsed clean through a valve, not replaced
Fitted at the point of entry, before everything else in the property
Clear bowl so the sand and rust it is catching is visible
Available for cold lines and for hot water lines

whoItSuits.title: Villas on tanker or tank supply
whoItSuits.body: Where sediment loading is high enough that a disposable cartridge becomes a recurring chore.

whoItSuits.title: Properties with older incoming pipework
whoItSuits.body: Rust and scale flaking from old galvanised pipe is exactly what this stage catches.

whoItSuits.title: Anyone with a softener or filtration downstream
whoItSuits.body: Sediment in a resin bed or on a membrane is difficult to recover from. This is the stage that prevents it.

howItFits: Fitted into the incoming supply ahead of every other treatment stage, with the drain valve piped to a point where flushing it is convenient rather than messy.
A pressure-gauge version makes developing blockage visible before flow to the property drops, which is worth having where nobody is checking the bowl regularly.

maintenance.title: Rinse rather than replace
maintenance.body: Open the drain valve and the mesh flushes itself. Frequency depends entirely on loading — weekly on a heavily tankered property, far less on mains supply.

maintenance.title: Inspect the mesh periodically
maintenance.body: A reusable element is not a permanent one. It is checked at service visits.

maintenance.title: Watch the pressure differential
maintenance.body: The honest indicator that a rinse is due, ahead of any visible symptom.

considerations.title: It is a sediment stage, nothing more
considerations.body: It does not remove chlorine, taste, hardness or dissolved solids, and it does not disinfect. Its value is protecting what comes after it.

considerations.title: Needs a drain point
considerations.body: The flush has to go somewhere. Solving that at installation is easier than living with a bucket.

specNote: Exact capacities, dimensions, stage counts and pump specifications are confirmed per model on the written quotation, after the water test and the site survey. We do not publish specification tables, because the configuration is chosen for your property rather than picked from a catalogue.

operatingLimits.label: Nominal filtration
operatingLimits.value: 90 micron (50 micron with a pleated element)
operatingLimits.note: Read this number carefully before believing any 'whole house filter' marketing. At 90 micron it removes sand, rust and scale flakes. It does not touch chlorine, hardness, taste, dissolved solids or bacteria — and it is not supposed to.

operatingLimits.label: Working pressure
operatingLimits.note: Some models are rated to 10 bar. Below the minimum the backwash will not clear the mesh properly.

operatingLimits.label: Working temperature
operatingLimits.note: Fitting a cold-rated body on a hot line is a failure waiting to happen, and it is a mistake we do find on existing installations.

operatingLimits.label: Flow capacity by connection
operatingLimits.note: Capacity follows the connection size, so the pipe it is fitted to sets the ceiling. Undersizing here throttles the whole property.

operatingLimits.label: Drain requirement
operatingLimits.note: The flush has to go somewhere, and the drain must not be able to siphon back into the supply. Solving this at installation is much easier than retrofitting it.

limitsNote: These are the published figures for representative point-of-entry self-cleaning filters, from manufacturer documentation held on file. They are not a quotation: the nominal filtration rating is the number worth understanding before buying anything sold as a whole-house filter, and the size actually fitted to your property is confirmed in writing after the site survey.

name: AquaPure Whole-Villa Filtration System
blurb: Large-capacity housings on a steel frame that treat every outlet in the property. We configure it as a single, double or triple stage after testing your water — there is no point paying for stages your villa does not need.
features: Single, double or triple stage, configured to your water test
Large housings for long cartridge life and strong flow to the whole villa
Clear or solid bowls — clear lets you see when a change is due
Steel frame for wall or floor mounting in the pump room or roof
Gauge and drain ports so servicing does not mean draining the villa
Removes sediment, chlorine, taste and odour before the first tap
metaDescription: Point-of-entry filtration sized for UAE villas in single, double or triple stage configurations. Treats every tap, shower and appliance in the property.
directAnswer: Large-capacity housings on a steel frame that treat every outlet in the property, configured as single, double or triple stage after a water test. More stages are not automatically better — stages your water does not need cost money at installation and again at every service.
keyFacts: Treats every tap, shower and appliance in the property
Single, double or triple stage, configured to your water test
Large housings for longer cartridge life and strong whole-property flow
Gauge and drain ports so servicing does not mean draining the villa

whoItSuits.title: Villas and townhouses
whoItSuits.body: You control the incoming line and there is space for a serviceable frame — the two conditions point-of-entry treatment needs.

whoItSuits.title: Properties with shower or appliance complaints
whoItSuits.body: Chlorine smell in the shower, sediment in the washing machine, rust marks in a bath. None of those have a point-of-use solution.

whoItSuits.title: Buildings and accommodation blocks
whoItSuits.body: One treatment point serving many outlets, sized on measured demand.

howItFits: Mounted on a steel frame in the pump room, plant room or on the roof, cut into the incoming supply with isolation and bypass valves so the property keeps water during a service.
Housing size is chosen for cartridge life and for flow to the furthest outlet. Undersizing to save space starves the property's flow and shortens cartridge life at the same time.

maintenance.title: Cartridge intervals follow loading
maintenance.body: Set from what the removed cartridges actually look like on this property, not from a generic schedule.

maintenance.title: Pressure drop is the health indicator
maintenance.body: A gauge before and after reports a developing blockage before flow noticeably falls.

maintenance.title: Clear bowls make it visible
maintenance.body: Where the system is not in direct sunlight, a clear bowl lets you see when a change is due.

considerations.title: It is not a drinking-water system
considerations.body: Point-of-entry filtration does not remove dissolved solids and does not disinfect. A drinking-water stage at the kitchen sink is a separate fitting, usually fitted alongside.

considerations.title: Hardness needs a softener, not a filter
considerations.body: If the complaint is white scale, the answer is ion exchange. Filtration stages will not change it.

considerations.title: Site it sheltered, especially near the coast
considerations.body: Salt-laden air shortens the life of exposed metalwork noticeably.

specNote: Exact capacities, dimensions, stage counts and pump specifications are confirmed per model on the written quotation, after the water test and the site survey. We do not publish specification tables, because the configuration is chosen for your property rather than picked from a catalogue.

operatingLimits.label: Cartridge format
operatingLimits.value: 4.5 inch outer diameter, 10 or 20 inch length
operatingLimits.note: The 'Big Blue' format. Larger housings mean longer cartridge life and less pressure drop across the property — the reason whole-property filtration does not use under-sink cartridges.

operatingLimits.label: Configurations
operatingLimits.value: single, double or triple stage manifold
operatingLimits.note: Stage count follows the water test. A triple fitted where a single was needed is money spent on cartridges forever.

limitsNote: These are the published formats for representative large-housing point-of-entry filtration, from manufacturer documentation held on file. Stage count, media choice and housing size are specified from your water test and measured demand, and confirmed on the written quotation.

name: AquaPure Chemical-Free Disinfection Unit
blurb: Disinfection without chemicals, electricity or a lamp to replace. The water passes through a ceramic media that destroys bacteria on contact, and comes out tasting exactly as it went in.
features: Kills bacteria on contact — nothing is dosed into your water
Needs no electricity, so it keeps working through a power cut
No lamp to replace, unlike a UV chamber
Leaves taste, odour and mineral content unchanged
Fits at the point of entry, or in-line before a drinking tap
Silent, with no moving parts to fail
metaDescription: Ceramic-media disinfection that destroys bacteria on contact without chemicals, electricity or a UV lamp. Fitted at point of entry or before a drinking tap.
directAnswer: A contact-disinfection stage using a ceramic media that acts on bacteria as water passes through it — no chemicals dosed, no electricity, and no lamp to replace. It is the alternative to UV where mains power at the installation point is inconvenient or where a power cut must not interrupt protection.
keyFacts: Acts on contact — nothing is dosed into the water
Needs no electricity, so a power cut does not interrupt it
No lamp or sleeve to replace, unlike a UV chamber
Leaves taste, odour and mineral content unchanged

whoItSuits.title: Properties where power at the fitting point is awkward
whoItSuits.body: The main reason to choose this over UV. No supply to run, no circuit to protect.

whoItSuits.title: Seasonally used and remote properties
whoItSuits.body: Nothing to fail silently while nobody is there, and no lamp whose life is quietly running out.

whoItSuits.title: Anyone wanting disinfection without chemicals
whoItSuits.body: No chlorine dosing, no by-products, no change to how the water tastes.

howItFits: Fitted at the point of entry, or in-line ahead of a drinking tap, after filtration — the same rule as UV: particles and turbidity reduce the effectiveness of any contact or light-based disinfection stage.
Silent, with no moving parts, which makes siting easier than a powered chamber.

maintenance.title: Media has a service life
maintenance.body: Longer than a UV lamp's, but not indefinite. It is checked and replaced on schedule.

maintenance.title: Upstream filtration still matters
maintenance.body: Sediment reaching the media reduces contact effectiveness and shortens its life.

considerations.title: It removes nothing
considerations.body: Like UV, it is a disinfection stage rather than a filtration stage. Dissolved solids, chlorine and sediment all need their own treatment.

considerations.title: Compare honestly with UV
considerations.body: UV is well understood, standardised and easy to monitor with an alarm. Contact media wins on power independence and on having nothing that fails weekly. Which matters more depends on the property.

specNote: Exact capacities, dimensions, stage counts and pump specifications are confirmed per model on the written quotation, after the water test and the site survey. We do not publish specification tables, because the configuration is chosen for your property rather than picked from a catalogue.

operatingLimits.label: Maximum flow
operatingLimits.note: Contact media works by residence time, so exceeding the rated flow reduces effectiveness rather than producing an alarm. Sizing against real peak demand matters.

operatingLimits.label: Rated capacity
operatingLimits.note: Service life is measured in throughput rather than months, which is a genuine difference from a UV lamp's annual replacement.

operatingLimits.label: Power required
operatingLimits.note: It keeps disinfecting through a power cut. A UV chamber does not, and on a tank-fed villa that is a real distinction.

operatingLimits.label: Published reduction
operatingLimits.value: up to Log 6 for the organisms tested
operatingLimits.note: A manufacturer laboratory figure for specified organisms (E. coli, MS2) under test conditions — Log 6 meaning a 99.9999% reduction. Laboratory performance is not a guarantee of the same result on your property, which is why disinfection is specified alongside a water test rather than instead of one.

limitsNote: These are the published duty figures for representative chemical-free contact disinfection equipment, from manufacturer documentation held on file. They are not a quotation. The microbiological figure is the manufacturer's own laboratory result, scoped exactly as they scope it; we have not independently verified it and do not present it as ours. What suits your property is confirmed in writing after the water test and site survey.

name: AquaPure Automatic Water Softener
blurb: UAE water is hard, and hardness is what scales your kettle, clouds your shower glass and shortens the life of every appliance that heats water. A softener treats it at the source, for the whole property.
features: Automatic regeneration — it manages itself once we set it up
Resin volume sized to your household's actual usage
Brine tank with a safety float against overflow
Salt supply and refill scheduling if you would rather not carry bags
Noticeable difference to skin, hair and laundry within days
Protects geysers, washing machines, taps and glassware from scale
metaDescription: Automatic ion-exchange water softener sized to your household and installed across all Emirates. Ends limescale on taps, glass, geysers and appliances.
directAnswer: An automatic ion-exchange softener that reduces the dissolved calcium and magnesium behind limescale, sized to your measured hardness and actual household demand. It regenerates itself with salt on a timer or on volume treated, and it treats the whole property rather than one tap.
keyFacts: Reduces hardness across every outlet, so scale stops forming
Automatic regeneration — timer or metered, set at commissioning
Salt is flushed to drain during regeneration; it does not make water taste salty
Not a drinking-water treatment — dissolved solids other than hardness pass through

whoItSuits.title: Villas with scale on fittings and glass
whoItSuits.body: The clearest case, and where the return is largest because the same water reaches several bathrooms, a geyser and a washing machine.

whoItSuits.title: Households losing appliances early
whoItSuits.body: Scale on a heating element is both a failure risk and a running-cost increase.

whoItSuits.title: Commercial kitchens and laundries
whoItSuits.body: Coffee, steam and dishwashing equipment specify soft feed water, and scale is the leading cause of failure in it.

howItFits: Installed into the incoming supply with a bypass and a drain connection for regeneration, and — where an irrigation line shares the supply — with a take-off ahead of the softener, since plants gain nothing from softened water.
The salt tank needs to be somewhere you can actually carry salt to. Solving that at installation rather than afterwards is worth the thought.

maintenance.title: Salt level
maintenance.body: A softener out of salt keeps passing water untreated with no obvious symptom until the scale returns.

maintenance.title: Brine draw and drain
maintenance.body: Checked at service. A failed brine valve is the fault behind almost every genuine complaint of salty water.

maintenance.title: Settings versus reality
maintenance.body: Household usage changes. Regeneration settings should be revisited when it does, rather than left as commissioned.

considerations.title: Metered regeneration where budget allows
considerations.body: It regenerates on volume treated rather than on a schedule, which uses less salt and less water.

considerations.title: Protect the resin
considerations.body: A sediment and carbon stage ahead of the softener materially extends resin life, particularly on chlorinated supply.

considerations.title: Size on hardness and demand together
considerations.body: Specifying from household size alone, without a hardness figure, is specifying from half the information.

specNote: Exact capacities, dimensions, stage counts and pump specifications are confirmed per model on the written quotation, after the water test and the site survey. We do not publish specification tables, because the configuration is chosen for your property rather than picked from a catalogue.
